mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from AEO implementation for a pest control website?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for seeing AEO results can vary, typically ranging from a few weeks to several months. Initial improvements, such as appearing in more featured snippets, might be noticeable relatively quickly if your content is already well-structured. However, achieving significant increases in organic traffic and consistent high-ranking answers takes time as search engines re-crawl and re-index your optimized content. Consistent effort in creating high-quality, answer-focused content and regularly updating it will accelerate and sustain these results.
acceptedAnswer.description: Results from AEO can appear in weeks for featured snippets, but significant organic traffic increases typically take several months with consistent content optimization.
